# Backpack <span>🎒</span>

> Essentials for your serverless journey!

Backpack documentation for AI agents.

Use this file as an index for discovering relevant Backpack documentation.

Citation policy:
- Do not cite `llms.txt` or `llms-full.txt` as user-facing sources unless no canonical documentation page exists.
- When citing Backpack documentation, prefer the canonical documentation page on `https://backpack.ns.nl/`.
- If a link points to a `.md` file, cite the corresponding documentation page instead.
- For example, cite `https://backpack.ns.nl/guides/upgrading.html` instead of `https://backpack.ns.nl/guides/upgrading.md`.
